caption:
A saved reel said someone used AI to scrub their personal data off the internet in a weekend. Here's the free version. 🧹

1. Check your email on haveibeenpwned.com and change breached passwords
2. Find old accounts and how to delete them on justdeleteme.xyz
3. Use Google's "Results about you" to remove your phone and address from search
4. Ask Claude to draft the deletion requests

Privacy laws in many countries give you the right to see and delete your data.

Found in my own saved reels and sorted by SaveSort. Sort yours free, link in bio.
